name: chain
description: A simple parent -> child -> grandchild chain. Importance flows down and the expected order is obvious -- the smoke test.

nodes.label: Unrelated standalone task, same own importance as task_under_chain

notes: Both leaves start at the identical own importance (0.3). task_under_chain must outrank task_standalone purely because of the chain beneath a strategic goal -- if this fails, nothing else will pass either. task_standalone has no parent at all, so any positive boost from initiative_q4 is enough to produce the stated order; this fixture is the smoke test, not the depth check -- 03_deep_nesting is where a one-hop-only read of the parent is deliberately made to lose to the correct full walk to the root. This order assumes the add-only combination rule (see README.md's Design decisions, "A parent can only add, never remove") -- under a multiplicative model (0.3*0.1*0.9=0.027) task_under_chain would lose to task_standalone's bare 0.3, flipping the order.
